name: Dr. Anisha Munshi
title: Superintendent, Gilroy Unified School District
background: Munshi is the Superintendent of Gilroy Unified School District. In that role she was the certifying official on the Tax Rate Statement for Measure M, the district's November 2026 general obligation bond measure, which she signed and filed with Santa Clara County on May 28, 2026, the same day the Board of Education voted unanimously to place the measure on the ballot following a Facilities Master Plan process and a commissioned voter survey. (Sources: Gilroy Unified School District, Complete Text of Measure M and Tax Rate Statement; scc-measure-m-2026.json in this voter guide.)

The district's superintendent webpage confirms her title but does not include the biography it links to, and this research found no other source for her career history, education, or start date, so those are left out.

What can be said with sourcing: as superintendent, Munshi has overseen a Facilities Master Plan process at Gilroy Unified that fed directly into Measure M's bond project list, and the district's Board of Education (President Tuyen Fiack, Vice President Michelle Nelson) worked with her and Assistant Superintendent of Business Services Alvaro Meza to bring the measure to voters. (Source: scc-measure-m-2026.json.)
